description: Changes a reward's name, stamps needed or description, or turns it off. Only the fields passed change.

active.description: false hides the reward from customers and staff.

intent.description: Optional. One short sentence on what the person asked you to do, e.g. "Set up a stamp card for Ground Up Café". Leal shows it in the person's activity log under Settings → AI agents, so they can see what was done for them. Leave out customer details.

reward_id.description: Reward id from list_cards or get_store_setup.

name: update_reward
title: Update a reward
